Yes, the 30-day evaluation cycle is stricter than what Part 2.2 requires.

According to the regulatory technical basis for the requirement, the standard mandates that entities "**At least once every 35 calendar days, evaluate security patches for applicability that have been released since the last evaluation from the source or sources identified in Part 2.1**" [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec].

The operator's recorded decision confirms that the 30-day cycle is a deliberate choice for increased strictness: "**We evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows, because our change window is monthly and a 35-day clock straddles two windows. The extra strictness is deliberate and is not a gap**" [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3].
